'''Ria''' is a female Black Shores NPC at [[The Black Shores]]. She is often found next to [[Gedao]].

''(To be added)''
{{Quests and Events|Ria}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Night at [[Haven of Sprouts]])
:'''Ria:''' Mmm, the pastries are so good! Want some?
:'''Gedao:''' Thanks, but I'm not in the mood. My task is due tomorrow. Gotta burn the midnight oil. Maybe you should just eat me so I'll never have to work again.
:'''Ria:''' Nice joke. But seriously, you should eat something. It's easier to work on a full stomach, don't you think?
:'''Ria:''' Next time we're on vacation, we should go to [[Jinzhou]] and try the local dishes!

==Dialogue==
;(Day at [[TD Observatory]])
:'''Ria:''' Check this out, Gedao! Pastries from Xiehua Village! [[Aalto]] and [[Encore]] brought it back from Jinzhou for us.
:'''Ria:''' I've been handling Jinzhou-related affairs, but I've never actually been there myself. All I know is data, just data.
:'''Ria:''' Remember Xiehua Village? I once sent an alert to the Wutherological Climate Studies Center at Huaxu Academy, warning them about a potential Waveworn in that area.
:'''Ria:''' I never expected to get a gift from that village. It feels like the locals are acknowledging my work.
:'''Ria:''' Speaking of which, I wonder how things are in Jinzhou now...
:'''Gedao:''' Still under observation, but we don't have time to dwell on it. With Tethys affected by corrupted data, we've got a ton of data to process.
:'''Gedao:''' Ha, another day of overtime...
{{Dialogue End}}
